description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Intrinio's Unusual Options Data, including query parameters, data representation, validation, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: IntrinioOptionsUnusualQueryParams
classes.description: Model for query parameters for Intrinio's Unusual Options activity API, including validation and aliasing.

classes.name: IntrinioOptionsUnusualData
classes.description: Model representing individual data entries for Intrinio's Unusual Options activity, with validation for timestamp and symbol formatting.

classes.name: IntrinioOptionsUnusualFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process Intrinio's Unusual Options data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an IntrinioOptionsUnusualQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from Intrinio's API, handling pagination and filtering.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of IntrinioOptionsUnusualData instances, raising an error if data is empty.
